**Summary**: AIM Intelligence is reported to have widened its cybersecurity collaboration with OpenAI and unveiled a new security assessment service, Stinger-Daybreak.

### Key Points
- AIM Intelligence has reportedly expanded the scope of its cybersecurity work with OpenAI.
- Stinger-Daybreak was introduced alongside it as a security assessment service.
- The announcement was distributed via EIN News on October 23.
- The specifics of the collaboration, how the service evaluates systems, and its availability and pricing are not covered in the information available so far.

### Why It Matters
As AI models move into production, third-party security assessments that probe a model's own weaknesses are becoming a market of their own. A closer tie between a model developer and a security specialist fits that trend. How useful the service is will only be clear once details are published.
